title: Diagnostic walkthrough tiles: lightweight onboarding assets for troubleshooting (rate limits, timeouts, retries)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a set of compact, exportable UX assets and screenshot overlays used in the Quickstart and Troubleshooting docs. These assets should explain common error states (rate limiting, request timeouts, and retry behaviors) with an emphasis on actionable next steps, minimal copy, and consistent iconography for both light and dark themes. Deliverables: 1) three diagnostic tile templates (Rate Limit, Timeout, Retry) in Figma with component variants, 2) screenshot overlay sprites for Console pages (Streams & Jobs, Model Routes, Request Inspector), 3) animated GIFs demonstrating progressive recovery (auto-retry backoff, reduced batch size), 4) copy micro-variants for microcopy A/B tests, and 5) image export pack (SVG, PNG @2x, WebP) and a short implementation guide for engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Tiles are implemented as Figma components with variants for severity (info/warning/error) and theme (light/dark)
Each tile includes: concise title (max 6 words), one-line cause, two-step actionable suggestions, and a linkable CTA label for docs
Screenshot overlays align to Console DOM grid (120px gutters) and adapt to 1000x600 and 1366x768 aspect ratios
Export pack includes SVG icon set, PNG 2x for all tiles, and three animated GIFs demonstrating retry/backoff and manual retry flow
Microcopy approved by Docs and Support; assets integrated into one Quickstart doc and one Troubleshooting doc example
Implementation guide contains CSS guidance and a lightweight accessibility checklist (focusable CTAs, ARIA labels)
Handoff includes Figma link, a small Loom walkthrough, and a target GitHub PR reference for dev integration
tasks: Draft visual language and icon set (Aisha)
Create tile component variants in Figma (Tomás)
